name: 91101 · Pasadena, CA
findings: ZIP 91101 (Pasadena) has 463 nonprofit organizations. 153 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 134 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91101 (Pasadena) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
63% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
